description: Model the RKN TolC homolog as a trimer on the 1EK9 frame and compare pore radius profiles
code:
import requests, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'research-agent/1.0'})
t2o=dict(zip("ALA ARG ASN ASP CYS GLN GLU GLY HIS ILE LEU LYS MET PHE PRO SER THR TRP TYR VAL".split(),"ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"))
def parse(txt,chains=None):
    out={}
    for l in txt.splitlines():
        if not l.startswith("ATOM"): continue
        ch=l[21]
        if chains and ch not in chains: continue
        rn=int(l[22:26]); an=l[12:16].strip(); res=l[17:20].strip(); el=(l[76:78].strip() or an[0])
        if el=='H': continue
        xyz=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))
        d=out.setdefault(ch,{'ca':{}, 'res':{}, 'all':[], 'b':{}}); d['all'].append(xyz)
        if an=='CA' and res in t2o: d['ca'][rn]=xyz; d['res'][rn]=t2o[res]; d['b'][rn]=float(l[60:66])
    for ch,d in out.items():
        rs=sorted(d['ca']); d['nums']=np.array(rs); d['seq']="".join(d['res'][r] for r in rs)
        d['CA']=np.array([d['ca'][r] for r in rs]); d['ALL']=np.array(d['all']); d['BF']=np.array([d['b'][r] for r in rs])
    return out
af=parse(S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8DII1-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text)['A']
ek=parse(S.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/1EK9.pdb",timeout=60).text,chains="ABC")

# --- sequence alignment (simple NW, identity scoring) to pair CA atoms ---
def nw_pairs(a,b):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); INF=-1e9
    sc=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); tb=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    sc[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*-1.0; sc[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*-1.0; tb[1:,0]=1; tb[0,1:]=2
    bar=np.array([1 if c else 0 for c in [True]])
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        row=np.where(np.frombuffer(b.encode(),dtype='S1')==ai.encode(),2.0,-1.0)
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            o=(sc[i-1,j-1]+row[j-1], sc[i-1,j]-2.0, sc[i,j-1]-2.0); k=int(np.argmax(o)); sc[i,j]=o[k]; tb[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; P=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        k=tb[i,j]
        if k==0: P.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif k==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return P[::-1], sc[n,m]
pairs,_=nw_pairs(af['seq'], ek['A']['seq'])
nid=sum(1 for i,j in pairs if af['seq'][i]==ek['A']['seq'][j])
print(f"Q8DII1 vs 1EK9:A  aligned pairs={len(pairs)}  identities={nid} ({100*nid/len(pairs):.1f}%)")

def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,S_,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); D=np.diag([1,1,d]); R=Vt.T@D@U.T
    return R, qc-R@pc
def superpose(mob_ca, ref_ca, pairs):
    P=mob_ca[[i for i,_ in pairs]]; Q=ref_ca[[j for _,j in pairs]]
    for _ in range(6):
        R,t=kabsch(P,Q); Pt=(R@P.T).T+t; d=np.linalg.norm(Pt-Q,axis=1)
        keep=d<max(3.5,np.percentile(d,70))
        if keep.sum()<30: break
        P,Q=P[keep],Q[keep]
    R,t=kabsch(P,Q); rms=np.sqrt(((((R@P.T).T+t)-Q)**2).sum(1).mean())
    return R,t,rms,len(P)
R,t,rms,ncore=superpose(af['CA'],ek['A']['CA'],pairs)
print(f"Kabsch superposition of AF-Q8DII1 onto 1EK9 chain A: core RMSD={rms:.2f} A over {ncore} CA")

# build pseudo-trimer: superpose AF monomer onto each of A,B,C
tri=[]
for c in "ABC":
    pr_,_=nw_pairs(af['seq'],ek[c]['seq'])
    Rc,tc,rc,nc=superpose(af['CA'],ek[c]['CA'],pr_)
    tri.append((Rc@af['ALL'].T).T+tc)
    print(f"  onto chain {c}: RMSD={rc:.2f} A over {nc} CA")
TRI=np.vstack(tri); NAT=np.vstack([ek[c]['ALL'] for c in "ABC"])

def axis_frame(P):
    cen=P.mean(0); u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(P-cen,full_matrices=False); e3=vt[0]
    e1=np.cross(e3,[0,0,1.0]); e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1); e2=np.cross(e3,e1)
    return (P-cen)@np.vstack([e1,e2,e3]).T, cen, np.vstack([e1,e2,e3])
NATf,cen,Rf=axis_frame(NAT)
TRIf=(TRI-cen)@Rf.T
print("\nNative TolC trimer axial length: %.1f A"%np.ptp(NATf[:,2]))
print("Modelled RKN TolC trimer axial length: %.1f A"%np.ptp(TRIf[:,2]))

def profile(P,dz=2.0,rmax=24.0,grid=0.6,probe=1.7):
    zs=np.arange(P[:,2].min()+4,P[:,2].max()-4,dz)
    g=np.arange(-rmax,rmax+1e-9,grid); GX,GY=np.meshgrid(g,g); m=(GX**2+GY**2)<=rmax**2
    gx,gy=GX[m],GY[m]; out=[]
    for z in zs:
        sel=P[np.abs(P[:,2]-z)<6.0]
        if len(sel)<20: out.append(np.nan); continue
        d2=(gx[:,None]-sel[None,:,0])**2+(gy[:,None]-sel[None,:,1])**2+(z-sel[None,:,2])**2
        out.append(max(0.0,np.sqrt(d2.min(1)).max()-probe))
    return zs,np.array(out)
z1,p1=profile(NATf); z2,p2=profile(TRIf)
print("Native 1EK9: min pore radius %.2f A (z=%.1f); median %.2f; max %.2f"%(np.nanmin(p1),z1[np.nanargmin(p1)],np.nanmedian(p1),np.nanmax(p1)))
print("RKN model  : min pore radius %.2f A (z=%.1f); median %.2f; max %.2f"%(np.nanmin(p2),z2[np.nanargmin(p2)],np.nanmedian(p2),np.nanmax(p2)))
np.save("/tmp/prof.npy",np.array([np.pad(z1,(0,0)),p1],dtype=object),allow_pickle=True)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.6))
ax.plot(z1,p1,lw=2,label="E. coli TolC trimer (PDB 1EK9, crystal)")
ax.plot(z2,p2,lw=2,ls='--',label="Tvtlr1605 TolC homolog (AF model on 1EK9 frame)")
ax.axhline(3.0,color='0.4',lw=1,ls=':'); ax.text(z1.min(),3.1,"approx. radius needed for one beta-1,4-glucan chain (~3 A)",fontsize=8,color='0.3')
ax.set_xlabel("position along the 3-fold channel axis (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("probe-accessible pore radius (A)")
ax.set_title("Channel bore of the Thermostichus TolC homolog compared with E. coli TolC")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=.3); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
